recent_alarms.description: Turbine bay HVAC fan motor high vibration — 0.52 in/s peak exceeds 0.35 alarm setpoint
Condenser backpressure high — 2.51 inHg exceeds 2.50 inHg alarm setpoint
Condenser backpressure high-high — automatic turbine runback setpoint 3.0 inHg actuated

recent_operations.description: Engineering notified of HVAC fan A high vibration. Fan A tripped on automatic high-vibration protection at 0.89 in/s. Fan B placed in service. Condenser pit ambient temperature monitoring frequency increased.
HVAC turbine bay fan A tripped on high vibration 0.89 in/s. Fan B confirmed in service. WO-2024-11901 issued for fan A bearing replacement — parts on order, no firm completion date.

Increased CW pump speed from 85 percent to 100 percent in response to backpressure trend per shift supervisor direction. Effect: backpressure reduced by only 0.04 inHg — minimal improvement. Engineering evaluation requested. Operator notes: CW temperature increase alone cannot explain the magnitude of backpressure rise observed.

Turbine load runback automatically actuated at 3.0 inHg condenser backpressure. Reactor power reduced from 97 percent to 85 percent via automatic load follow. Operators entered EOPs and notified shift manager.

nearby_maintenance.notes: Condenser waterbox A tube cleaning and inspection per PM schedule. 847 tubes inspected, 0 tubes plugged, as-left acceptable. No abnormality found.
Fan A motor bearing replacement. Parts on order. Fan B providing full turbine bay ventilation coverage in interim.
